card.name: Per-unit words in counts and dosing intervals
card.fires_on: Words that distribute or space things per unit: "of" after a count like 1 (of 3 patients), "each", and "weeks" or "monthly" after "every 2/4" or "once". Seen in dosing schedules and case counts.

modes.label: Dosing interval
modes.description: "weeks" or "monthly" ending a repeat-interval phrase like every 4 weeks.
modes.example: followed by 1.75 mg/kg every 4<< weeks>> thereafter (maintenance dosage)

modes.label: Portion of a group
modes.description: "of" or "each" after a number, naming one part of a group of patients or people.
modes.example: were each observed in 1<< of>> 3 patients dosed at 2
